callbacks_source: Every callback case: expected.valid false means the SDK throws its signature verification error with exactly expected.message. Decoding errors, nested values, non-string signature fields and a signature, hash or checksum mismatch give "<Gateway> <thing> <signature|hash|checksum> verification failed."; checks that run after the signature matched give "Wave Pay callback is malformed.", "AYA Pay {context} payload is malformed." or "CyberSource callback is malformed.". A missing amount or gateway_reference means none.

url_validation.source: Every callback, return and cancel URL is checked like PHP FILTER_VALIDATE_URL plus an http/https scheme: printable ASCII only (no whitespace or control characters), "http://" or "https://" in any case followed by a host; the host is a bracketed IP literal or dot-separated labels of letters, digits and inner "-" (1 to 63 characters each, at most 253 in all, one trailing dot allowed); a port is 0 to 65535. User info, path, query and fragment may hold any printable ASCII. An invalid URL gives message for the field.
url_validation.message: The callbackUrl field must be a valid http or https URL.

query_escape.source: Values put in a query string (KBZ Pay callback_info, the Wave Pay redirect's transaction_id) are encoded like Go url.QueryEscape: letters, digits and "-_.~" stay, a space becomes "+", every other byte is %XX in uppercase hex. KBZ Pay's 512-character callbackInfo limit counts the encoded text.

ascii_trim.source: Blank checks and trimming use only ASCII whitespace and NUL (" \t\n\r\u0000\u000b"), like PHP trim(): a no-break space (U+00A0) or a byte order mark is a character, not whitespace. env: the value read for KBZ_PAY_APP_ID (app_id null means the missing-setting error); kbz_pay_order_id: the errors of a KBZ Pay payment with that orderId (amount 1000, callbackUrl https://shop.test/cb). Callback bodies, statuses and tokens follow the same rule (see the kbz_pay callbacks).

config_setting_types.source: String settings given in code (PHP fromArray, Node options, Python mappings) accept text and integers: an integer becomes its decimal text. Floats, booleans and blank text count as missing. Checked on cyber_source.profile_id with the rest of config.

config_integer_limits.source: Whole-number settings (the HTTP timeout and the time to live) hold at most 2147483647 (2^31 - 1); a larger value is invalid, never clamped. Each case sets one variable over config.env; seconds is the value read, otherwise key and message name the ConfigurationException.

wave_pay_validation.source: Wave Pay payment data rules. Each case applies data over this data (snake_case field names; an item is [name, amount] where a string amount is parsed as a decimal); errors lists the fields in validation order: orderId, callbackUrl, returnUrl, description, items, merchantReferenceId, merchantName, timeToLiveSeconds, additionalField3 to additionalField5, then each item's name and amount, then amount. Without amount, the total is the exact sum of the items: no items gives "The amount field is required.", and an item amount that is invalid or has decimals skips the total check (the item's own error is reported).

wave_pay_exact_amount.source: Amounts are exact: the JSON body carries the amount and each item amount as JSON numbers with every digit, with no integer limit, and the total is the exact sum of the items. amount_json is the exact JSON text of the body's amount member; items is the exact items string.

wave_pay_errors.source: A failed Wave Pay payment request throws the API error "Wave Pay payment request failed with HTTP {status}: {gateway_message}". Field errors count only when errors is a JSON object: "field: messages" pairs sorted by field and joined with "; ", each entry a list of messages (joined with " ") or a single one, objects skipped; otherwise message, or "unexpected response". gateway_code is VALIDATION_ERROR whenever the errors key is present (even null), else message. Uses wave_pay_request.config and wave_pay_limits.data.

cases.gateway_message: amount: too small; order_id: required too long

aya_pay_services.source: AYA Pay services(): data and each service's methods are read only when they are JSON lists; a service whose key is missing, empty or not a scalar is skipped; scalar fields are read as text (booleans as true/false); name falls back to key; image_url is null unless it is a scalar; method entries that are not scalars are skipped and unknown ones are listed in unknown_methods. A failed call with status "" has no gateway_code.

yoma_mmqr_responses.source: Yoma MMQR response reads. Each case calls status(argument) or renew_qr(argument) on a gateway built from config.env with responses served in order (the first is the token). errorCode "" (or a non-scalar) is no error; the message is errorDescription, or error_description when that is empty; "" is no message; the token call uses error and error_description the same way. qrString and refLabel are read as text (booleans as true/false) and must not be empty.

kbz_pay_responses.source: KBZ Pay response reads: scalars are read as text (booleans as true/false, numbers as sent), objects and lists as missing; trade_status is trimmed of ASCII whitespace; an empty merch_order_id falls back to the order id asked for; qrCode and prepay_id must be non-empty text. Each case answers status("ORDER_1") or qr() of a KBZ Pay payment (ORDER_1, 1000, https://shop.test/cb) on a gateway built from config.env.
